z-m-35-04.title: Xa ixabiso elinye lingabelwa naluphi na iseti
z-m-35-04.topic: Iseti yenyaniso yomqathango nexabiso lomda (ingaba kukho uphawu lokulingana)
z-m-35-04.goal: Jonga apho ixabiso lomda lingena khona kwiseti yenyaniso yomqathango wokungalingani ukugweba ukuba 'okanye' ihlala inyani, uze wenze iimeko ezininzi wena ezanelisa izithintelo ezinikiweyo kumqathango apho indawo yophawu lokulingana itshintshile.
z-m-35-04.material: Kwinani lokwenyani x, misela imiqathango neeseti zenyaniso zazo ngolu hlobo. [가] p: x<a, q: x>b. [나] p: x<a, q: x≥b. Apha a no-b ziikhonstanti, kwaye P no-Q ziiseti zenyaniso zika-p no-q ngokulandelelana. U-Minjae wasombulula imeko a=b=3 kwi-[가] ngolu hlobo. (Indlela yokufunda: ≥ ithetha 'likhulu okanye lilingana', kwaye x<a ithetha 'x incinci kune-a'.)
z-m-35-04.prereq.1: Ukubonisa iiseti zenyaniso zokungalingani x<a no-x≥b kumgca wamanani
z-m-35-04.prereq.2: Ukuba iseti yenyaniso yomqathango othi 'p okanye q' yi-P∪Q
z-m-35-04.s.s1.prompt: Ikuphi umgca wokuqala kwisisombululo sika-Minjae apho ingqiqo ihamba gwenxa? Bala amanani emigca ukusuka kwi-1.
z-m-35-04.s.s1.hint.0: Usebenzisa i-p ne-q emiselweyo kumgca 1, hlela inani ngalinye lokwenyani ngokuba lelika-p okanye lelika-q.
z-m-35-04.s.s1.hint.1: Cinga ukuba zi-x ezithini eziqukiwe kwi-"kuyo yonke inani lokwenyani x," uze ujonge umgca ngomgca ukuba umgca ngamnye uphathe zonke ezo x.
z-m-35-04.s.s1.line.0: Vumela a=b=3. Emva koko p yi-x<3 kwaye q yi-x>3.
z-m-35-04.s.s1.line.1: Ukuba x incinci kune-3, p inyani, kwaye ukuba x inkulu kune-3, q inyani.
z-m-35-04.s.s1.line.2: Imeko x=3 ayincinci kwaye ayikhulu kune-3, ngoko ayiyodwa icala, kwaye asiyimfuneko ukuyiqwalasela ngokwahlukileyo.
z-m-35-04.s.s1.line.3: Ngoko, kuwo onke amanani okwenyani x, 'p okanye q' inyani.
z-m-35-04.s.s1.explain: Ingxaki kukuba kumgca 3 uyazimisela ukuba x=3 ayiyonxalenye yamnye umqathango waza wathi 'asimele siyiqwalasele ngokwahlukileyo'. 'Kuwo onke amanani okwenyani x' iquka x=3 nayo, kwaye ukuba zombini p no-q zingamampunge kwi-x=3, ngoko 'p okanye q' ayinyaniso, ngoko kwi-[가] awukwazi ukuthi ukuba a=b inyani kuwo onke amanani okwenyani. Isigqibo kumgca 4 asilunganga ngenxa yomgca 3.
z-m-35-04.s.s2.prompt: Ngoku, kwi-[나] (p: x<a, q: x≥b), yenza ubhanxa abangu-3 abahlukileyo (a, b) abanelisa konke okulandelayo. (i) 'p okanye q' inyani kuwo onke amanani okwenyani x. (ii) Kukho amanani apheleleyo x angu-2 kanye anelisa zombini p no-q ngaxeshanye. a no-b banokuba ziidesimali.
z-m-35-04.s.s2.hint.0: Zoba P no-Q kumgca wamanani uze unqume ukuba b no-a kufuneka babe phi ukuze badibane ngaphandle kwesithuba.
z-m-35-04.s.s2.hint.1: Lungelelanisa amanani apheleleyo kwisithuba ukusuka kwi-b ukuya kodwa ungabandakanyi a, uze ulungise a no-b ukuze kubekho 2 kanye.
z-m-35-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Ukuba b inkulu kune-a, amanani asuka kwi-a ukuya kodwa angabandakanyi b anelisa nawe p ngenxa yoko q.
z-m-35-04.s.s2.ok.c2: Kukho amanani apheleleyo angu-2 kanye ukusuka kwi-b ukuya kodwa angabandakanyi a (umqathango (ii)).
z-m-35-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Inani lamanani apheleleyo ukusuka kwi-b ukuya kodwa angabandakanyi a alingu-2.
z-m-35-04.s.s2.explain: Kwi-[나], P iphantsi kwe-a kwaye Q ikwi-b okanye ngaphezulu. Ukuze idibaniselwano ibe onke amanani okwenyani, b≤a iyafuneka, kwaye amanani anelisa zombini ngaxeshanye asuka kwi-b ukuya kodwa angabandakanyi a. Kwanele ukuba kukho amanani apheleleyo angu-2 kanye apho, ngoko umzekelo (3,1) iqulathe i-1, 2, (2.5,0.5) iqulathe i-1, 2, kwaye (4.2,2.3) iqulathe i-3, 4. Ukuba b=a, akukho manani agqithisanayo kwaphela, ngoko (ii) ayanelisiwe.

z-m-35-05.title: Izivakalisi ezimbini ezinamagama afanayo ngolandelelwano olwahlukileyo: zithetha into enye?
z-m-35-05.goal: Sebenzisa itheyibhile ukujonga ukuba izivakalisi ezimbini ezahluke ngolandelelwano lwe-'kuyo yonke ... kukho' kunye ne-'enye ... yonke' azithethi omnye komnye, uze ufumane unxibelelwano olungalunganga uluchaze ngomzekelo ochasayo.
z-m-35-05.material: Abafundi abane 가, 나, 다, 라 bathumelelana amanqaku okukhuthaza. Akukho namnye othumele kuye ngokwakhe. Umgca ngamnye wetheyibhile ngu-'umthumeli → abamkeli'. [Itheyibhile 1] 가→나, 다, 라 / 나→다 / 다→나 / 라→다. [Itheyibhile 2] 가→나 / 나→다 / 다→라 / 라→가. Ingxelo ㄱ: Kuwo wonke umfundi, kukho umfundi owathumela inqaku kuloo mfundi. Ingxelo ㄴ: Omnye umfundi wathumela inqaku kwabanye bonke abafundi.
